recipes.name: Pineapple Bread Souffle
ingredients_raw: 5 slices white bread, cut into 1 inch cubes

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 6x10 inch baking dish.

Cream the butter and sugar together in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time. Stir in the bread cubes and pineapple until well blended. Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly over the top.
Bake in preheated oven until bread points on top are golden brown, 45 to 60 minutes. Cool before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Pineapple Bread Souffle
raw_recipe.description: Utterly simple, this down-home bread pudding-like of butter, sugar, eggs, white bread cubes, and crushed pineapple is irresistible as either a dessert or side dish. That long-lasting, favorite white bread is recommended as the best bread of choice.

review.reviewBody: This really is a delicious dish and you will definitely please your guests. I have to say, the first time I made it, I followed the directions and while it tasted really good, it looked a little flat. The next time I made it I used 6 eggs, instead of 4 and 7 slices of bread instead of 5. It was perfect. NO leftovers! It was a big hit!

WOW! This was awesome! Very sweet and rich. Added 1/4 c of the juice because I put my bread on a cookie rack overnight and they turned into croutons - whoops! Used 6 slices of cheap white bread. Baked just perfect at 45 min. Will DEF do again!!! Update: just made this again for the 2nd time and used margarine (all I had on hand) and it was not as good as the first time with butter!!! Use butter!!!

This is the simplest recipe and is flat naughty. I went to a wedding that served this as a side dish and everyone couldn't get enough of it. I came home destined to find this recipe and found it here of course. The only addition that I made was an extra slice of bread. This recipe takes literally 5 minutes to get in the oven. I've served it at Thanksgiving as a side to bake ham and also as a dessert. Adding a little ice cream to the dish is always good as a dessert too. The dish is always empty and the first to go. The items are always in most pantry cupboards which makes it great. Kids and adults love it. I've had to give this recipe to many and still get requests. Give it a try you won't regret it especially if you love a custard or bread pudding.......YUM!
UPDATE: I have made this so many times and I can't have Thanksgiving without it. I have expanded on it although it is awesome the way it is. Try adding a handful of golden raisins and some toasted pecans......so delish!

Not sure why this is titled souffle, since it’s closer to a bread pudding. I scaled the recipe in half, and it came out a little on the dry side after 35 minutes in the oven. I used sourdough bread (what was on hand) instead of regular white bread, so maybe that had something to do with it? I’d reserved the extra pineapple and its juice, so I just drizzled some on to moisten as well as adding a little cream, and we enjoyed this as a dessert, not a side dish. Would recommend that you keep your eye on the timing, perhaps start checking for doneness at 30 minutes.

I made a mistake and creamed both the white and brown sugar together. It still turned out really delicious. I sprinkled the top with a little more brown sugar and put on a few maraschino cherries before baking. I also added 1/8 tsp of vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon to the batter.

I used 6 eggs and 8 slices of white sandwich bread, half a teaspoon of vanilla, only used 1/2 cup white sugar and the brown sugar, and I sprinkled brown sugar on top. My family said it was amazing. This was my first time trying it, I think I will keep my adjustments but cook a little longer next time, was a little too mushy for my liking.
I added orange zest for a wonderful flavor, used 6 breads. Great!!!!!!!!!!!

Yum! I had half a can of crushed pineapple to use up, so decided to try this recipe. I halved all ingredients except the bread. I used a full 3 slices. I also baked it in the small individual baking cups as shown in the pictures. It made 4 individual servings and took about 40 minutes to bake. Started them at 325 degrees and turned it up to 350 for the last 10 minutes. They turned out great. Only problem I had is where to store the recipe. Dessert? Bread? Breakfast? Sidedish? Works for all four!

Good way to use up bread! I made it according to recipe, but my friend got the idea to make it apple souffle by using 1c applesauce instead of pineapple (and adding 1/4 tsp vanilla.) This is a good variation for someone who wants something milder, but if I hadn't known it was applesauce instead of pineapple...it might have fooled me!

It's a great recipe - my family loved it, especially the leftovers. However, the sugar content is way too much, so I cut it to 1/2 cup of sugar and it was still quite sweet. I did add 1/4 c. of the juice. I am planning to serve it at my New Year's brunch.

Great dish for potlucks! This is really easy and cheap to make! I used 5 eggs instead of 4 and an extra piece of bread for a 9X9 pan. I also used regular white sugar instead of brown. It was good but not as sweet as I was hoping, so next time I'll add a bit more sugar in the mix. All in all though, it was a win in my house.
Tried this last year and it our new favorite. Pairs really well with ham and is yummy hot or cold.
Delicious! Pairs perfectly with ham!
ADDED CINNAMON
Always a hit

I absolutely love it and just sent it to one of my daughters who used to love pineapple upside down cake when she was a kid. This is so simple and so delicious! I made half a recipe and froze the other half can of pineapple for the next time
Such an amazing groovy soufflé!! So amazing I didn't dare change a thing!! Thank you
Never get tired of this and today I added fresh Mango and it's even better than ever.

So you’re supposed to let this cool before serving but I don’t have that kind of willpower. The smell was phenomenal and the taste was WOW. Just the right amount of crunch on top and bottom and perfectly soft in the middle. I LOVE bread pudding but this tastes like Bread Pudding and Cobbler got together and had a baby. A VERY tasty baby. Definitely a repeat!! Thank you SO much for the awesome recipe!!!!
